protocol.purpose: Execution measurement; no strategy optimization or order authority.
protocol.clocks: Matched decision quotes at open +1s/+30s and close -1s. Cached depth at those clocks +100ms.
protocol.pilot: 100 deterministic round-robin strata by entry year, listing venue and prior-volume tercile; no outcome feature.
protocol.denominators: All targeted events remain in coverage counts. Full-book costs are conditional on sufficient displayed quantity on both legs, never an admission screen.
protocol.same_shares: Whole shares floor(ticket / official opening auction price), bought back in full; no favorable cover-dollar resizing.
protocol.costs: Spread + displayed-book depth + separate fixed commissions. Auction-to-continuous timing is reported separately. No added flat depth proxy.
protocol.impact: Static sweeps assume simultaneous access to displayed venues; cancellations, replenishment, our market impact, queue priority and actual fills remain unmeasured.
protocol.funding: Execution audit excludes borrow, proceeds interest, margin funding and regulatory/exchange charges.

access.note: Databento access verified. EQUS.SIP and EQUS.ALL returned dataset_not_found through the authenticated historical API. Available EQUS.MINI is a derived venue-subset BBO from 2023-03-28, not official NBBO. New downloads are capped at $0 by request. The sampled quote/depth requests have positive usage prices, so none were downloaded. Existing cached-data estimates are unchanged.

limits: Multi-venue quotes cover observed feeds, not official consolidated NBBO.
Cached decision quotes are matched exactly in clock; depth books add a modeled 100ms response and may mix sampled top quotes with deeper books.
Full-order statistics exclude unsupported orders and are conditional on future cover depth; missing costs are not zero and these are not strategy returns.
Different size rows have different surviving samples. Common-support rows hold the same events fixed but select a liquid subset with hindsight.
Static books do not establish smart-router access, successful fills, replenishment, cancellations, price impact or borrow approval.
Auction-to-continuous timing is separate from spread/depth. Multi-session exits and stops need additional dated quote paths.
No real trades were submitted. New chargeable quote downloads require a budget; no purchase or subscription upgrade is performed.
